purpose: Active Web V1.1 §35.2 block 01 Infrastructure-only skeleton

transport.framing: uint32 little-endian byte length followed by that many UTF-8 JSON bytes; header not counted
transport.encoding: UTF-8 strict, duplicate keys/NaN/infinity rejected; closed objects

refs.pageRef: bwp_<32 lowercase hexadecimal characters> or null

envelope.deadline: integer UTC Unix milliseconds, positive and <=2^53-1; incoming request remaining budget in (0,30000] ms
envelope.payload: typed closed object; null is invalid
envelope.response: payload={} and exactly one of result/error non-null
envelope.protocolError: requestId/operationId/pageRef=null, browserSessionRef=owned session, payload={}, result=null, typed error; never invents a correlated operation

shutdown.successRequires: ack + correlated event + actual owned process exit code 0

cancellation.rule: must refer to a prior completed request with matching operation in this session; no duplicate own request/operation
cancellation.semantics: health is synchronous; no rollback or future browser STARTED cancellation claim
cancellation.localEvent: cancels startup/IPC IO, invalidates channel, cancels/drains native pending IO and reaps owned process; no operation retry

handshakeChecks: exact host identity and host-instance ref
Windows OS server PID equals Python-owned child PID before handshake
Windows OS client PID equals original Python owner PID
same requestId/operationId/pageRef/deadline on response and ready event
exact IPC features; activeWebAvailable strictly false

ownership.hostCreator: trusted Python Infrastructure composition, explicit absolute executable/assembly paths
ownership.acl: protected DACL: deny NETWORK; allow only actual current TokenUser (FILE_ALL_ACCESS); non-inherited
ownership.ownerLifetime: holds original process handle; owner exit cancels host, no reconnection
ownership.untrustedClient: rejected before handshake if PID not original owner; second simultaneous client cannot connect to single instance
ownership.threatModel: HOST_UNISOLATED; not protection against administrator, debugger, process injection, replacement of trusted runtime or assemblies
ownership.nameExposure: private implementation identifier, not a tool/model capability

lifecycle.failure: typed error -> FAILED, channel invalidated and child reaped; cleanup uncertainty remains explicit
lifecycle.notStartedShutdown: STOPPED without process or operation success fabricated
lifecycle.failedShutdown: cleanup only; does not change failed state to successful STOPPED

hostExitCodes.14: owner stop or native connection/frame timeout/cancellation

lifecycle.notes: Python distinguishes local timeout/cancellation, unexpected process exit and transport disconnect. Exit code 14 alone does not identify cancellation versus timeout.

deadlines.client: one monotonic budget covers lock wait, connection, write and all frame fragments; rejects late replies before committing result
deadlines.host: UTC wire deadline checked before synchronous health; native connection/read/write also independently bounded
deadlines.failureCleanup: separate finite terminate/kill waits; native pending IO drained before buffer release; not an Active Web semantic latency gate
